capabilities: Organize tasks in a color-coded 2x2 Eisenhower matrix view
Group tasks into named sections within each quadrant
Drag and drop tasks across sections, quadrants, and parent tasks
Nest tasks up to three levels of subtasks
Archive completed tasks to Eisenhower Archive.md under quadrant and section headings
extras: Tasks are stored in Obsidian's plugin data store rather than as Markdown tasks in notes, so they do not appear in regular notes or task searches. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for prioritizing tasks by urgency and importance; tasks scattered across notes are hard to triage visually.
summary: Eisenhower Matrix task board that organizes tasks into a 2x2 urgency/importance grid with sections, drag-and-drop, subtasks, and archiving.
